bio:
Sister of Ensign Thomas; married James Pringle, brother of Samuel, in 1785.

FamilySearch's 'Phebe Hart Lamoreaux' (31 Jan 1765 - 5 Apr 1856) is the wife of a James Pringle (1754-1828) ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch also makes that James Pringle a son of James and Anar Prindle of Newtown, born before their 1759 marriage. Her only source is a Geni/MyHeritage tree. The children's birthplaces (Pennsylvania 1786 and 1790, Orange Co. 1796, New York 1797, Connecticut 1799) suggest the family moved between Plymouth and the Hudson Valley.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.356-359
